description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'Date' that handles date arguments for views, including default date options based on current date or node timestamps.

classes.name: Drupal\views\Plugin\views\argument\Date
classes.description: A plugin class for handling date arguments in Drupal views, supporting default date options and formatting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the Date plugin, initializing route match, date formatter, and time services.

methods.name: defaultArgumentForm
methods.description: Adds options for default argument types, including current date and node timestamps.

methods.name: getDefaultArgument
methods.description: Returns the default date argument, formatted, based on current time or node timestamps.

methods.name: getSortName
methods.description: Returns the localized name for sorting by date.

methods.name: getFormula
methods.description: Returns the formula for the date argument, formatted appropriately.

methods.name: getArgFormat
methods.description: Returns the date format used in the query.
